prepareMoreInstruction: Prepare new exercises (different from the existing ones, with their solution and hints) to check “{{focus}}”.

ex.verified: Answer checked by a second, independent solver

ph.open: Write your answer in your own words…

note.equation: Write the whole equation, with its = sign
note.chemEquation: Use → for the arrow and balance the coefficients

order.start: Drag the items (or use the keyboard: space to pick one up, ↑ ↓ to move it) until they’re in order.
order.help: You can keep moving them until you check.
order.label: Items to order
order.grabbed: Picked up: move it with the arrows and drop it with space

match.help: Join each item on the left with its partner: drag from the dot, or click one and then the other.

label.name: Name
label.dragHelp: Drag each label onto its number (or click the label, then the number).

self.title: Grade yourself with the rubric
self.lead: Compare your answer with the model answer and tick what you covered.

ex.grading: Aula is grading your answer with the rubric…
ex.stale: You changed your answer: check it again

invalid.title: I couldn’t read your answer
invalid.body: Check how you wrote it and try again.

ex.hintCost: Each hint takes a little off this exercise’s score
ex.hintGuided: With a hint, this question no longer counts toward checking the concept: you’ll see another explanation and a new question.
ex.dontKnowHelp: Shows the solution; counts as a mistake and comes back later
ex.skipHelp: Go to the next one without seeing the solution

keys.union: Union of intervals (the letter U works too)

learn.title: Learn

modeHelp.guided: First an explanation and an example. Then you check what you learned; if something’s hard, we look at it another way before moving on.
modeHelp.explore: Go through the explanation and its questions at your own pace. You can skip an exercise and come back to it later.
modeHelp.reading: Read the explanations, examples and graphs. Finishing the reading doesn’t count as mastering the topic.

learn.gateSpot: You can look for the mistake
learn.checkLead: {{n}} of {{m}} correct on your own. Each check uses a different question.
learn.openLead: One answer with full marks, without hints, is enough to move on.
learn.assistedLead: With help, this question no longer counts toward checking the concept. Next you’ll see another explanation and a new question.
learn.masteredN_one: You solved {{count}} question on the first try, with no hints or solution.
learn.masteredN_other: You solved {{count}} different questions on the first try, with no hints or solution.
learn.masteredOpen: You solved it with full marks and no hints.
learn.masteredReading: This section has no questions: reading it is enough.
learn.uncheckedBody: The questions ran out and you chose to continue. Practice this topic when Aula prepares new exercises.
learn.reteachTitle: Let’s look at it another way
learn.reteachLead: Go through this reasoning. Then you’ll try it with a new question.
learn.exhaustedTitle: This concept is out of questions
learn.exhausted: You’ve used the questions this concept had. Aula can prepare new exercises, or you can continue without checking it.
learn.exhaustedOpen: You’ve answered this concept’s open questions. Aula can prepare others, or you can continue without checking it.
learn.preparing: Aula is preparing new exercises for this concept…
learn.prepared: They’re ready: you can keep checking.
learn.prepareFailed: More exercises couldn’t be prepared. Try again or continue without checking.
learn.continueUncheckedHelp: The concept is marked “not checked” and the lesson goes on
learn.noAI: To prepare new exercises, set up an AI provider in Settings.
learn.noTry: There are no exercises for this part.
learn.empty: This lesson has no content yet.
learn.noLessonTitle: This lesson has no content yet
learn.noLessonBody: Ask Aula to write it: tell it which topic you want and with which materials.
learn.askWrite: Write the lesson on “{{topic}}” with explanations, worked examples and questions to check it.
learn.tutorPrompt: Explain this concept another way, with a different example. Then add a new question to the course to check it.
learn.doneBody: You’ve checked every concept. Practice later to keep them fresh.
learn.doneUnchecked_one: One concept wasn’t checked because its questions ran out. Practice this topic when Aula prepares new exercises.
learn.doneUnchecked_other: {{count}} concepts weren’t checked because their questions ran out. Practice this topic when Aula prepares new exercises.
learn.doneReading: You’ve finished reading. To check what you learned, come back with “Learn step by step”.

practice.streakHelp: Correct in a row on the first try
practice.tutorPrompt: Explain why my answer isn’t right. Don’t give me the full solution yet.
practice.emptyBody: This topic has no exercises Aula can grade on its own yet.
practice.doneMissed: Every mistake goes into your notebook with its explanation and comes back with spaced review.
practice.doneClean: What you haven’t mastered yet comes back in a few days so it sticks.
practice.noAnswersBody: Answer at least one exercise to see your summary.

cards.title: Flashcard review
cards.recallFirst: Try to recall it before flipping the card
cards.nothingBody: Flashcards come back just before you’d forget them. In the meantime, practice a topic.
cards.doneBody: Your memory is consolidating. What you struggled with comes back soon: repeating just before forgetting is what makes it stick.
cards.doneAgain: The “Again” ones come back soon, just before you’d forget them.
cards.tomorrow_one: {{count}} flashcard is waiting for you tomorrow.
cards.tomorrow_other: {{count}} flashcards are waiting for you tomorrow.
cards.tomorrowNone: No flashcards are waiting for you tomorrow.

exam.title: Mock exam
exam.lead: No hints or explanations until you submit, like the real exam. If you leave, the clock pauses.
exam.noPast: You haven’t taken one yet. The first tells you where to start.
exam.pendingTitle: You have a mock exam in progress
exam.discardTitle: Discard the mock exam in progress?
exam.discardBody: Your answers so far will be lost. It won’t count in your history.
exam.newBody: You have one in progress: starting another discards its answers.
exam.question: Question {{n}}
exam.flagHelp: Flag the question to come back to it before submitting (⇧⌘L)
exam.missingQuestion: This question is no longer in the course.
exam.submitBody: After submitting you can’t change your answers; you’ll see each question with its explanation.
exam.allAnswered: You answered every question. Review any of them before submitting if you like.
exam.timeUpBody: Your answers can no longer be changed. Submit to see your score.

verdict.almost: Almost there: the pass mark is {{pass}}
verdict.good: You’ve got a good handle on it
verdict.justOk: Borderline: shore up the weak spots
verdict.notYet: Not yet: use this as a map

exam.goodBody: Keep the pace: review your few mistakes and go into the exam rested.
exam.workBody: Every question you missed is already in your mistakes notebook and will come back with spaced review. On the right, where to go next.
exam.nothingToReview: Nothing in particular: review the few mistakes below.
exam.practiceMissedHelp: With hints and the explanation of each mistake.
exam.questionsDetail: Click one to see your answer, the right one and its explanation.
exam.noExercises: No exercises for a mock exam yet
exam.noExercisesBody: This course doesn’t have any exercises yet. Ask Aula to add some from the course page, or create it again.
exam.submitFailed: Couldn’t submit the mock exam: it’s still open and saved, submit it again.

mistakes.title: Mistake review
mistakes.nothingBody: When you miss an exercise, it comes here with its explanation and returns after 1, 3, 7, 16 and 35 days.
mistakes.nothingDue_one: You have {{count}} open mistake, but it isn’t due yet.
mistakes.nothingDue_other: You have {{count}} open mistakes, but they aren’t due yet.
mistakes.doneMissed: What you still get wrong comes back soon; what you got right waits longer before returning.
mistakes.doneClean: All correct: each one comes back later and, after five reviews, it’s resolved.

plan.title: Study now
plan.lead: About {{minutes}} min, sorted by what raises your grade most.
plan.footer: After each step you come back here. You can skip any of them.
plan.emptyBody: You’re up to date. Practice a little to keep it fresh if you like.
plan.doneBody: Nice work. Tomorrow’s plan adapts to what you did today.

practice.mixedBody: Ten exercises from your weakest topics, interleaved and at your level: get them right and the level goes up; miss and it goes down.
practice.byTopicDetail: The ring is your mastery; click a topic to practice it

cards.emptyTitle: This course has no flashcards yet
cards.emptyBody: Ask Aula to prepare flashcards for the key concepts.

exam.pending: You have a mock exam in progress: {{answered}} of {{total}} answered.

mistakes.how: Each mistake comes back after 1, 3, 7, 16 and 35 days. Get it right in all those reviews and it’s resolved.
mistakes.gone: This exercise is no longer in the course
mistakes.resolveHelp: Marks it as resolved; it stops appearing in your reviews
mistakes.resolvedBody: It won’t appear in your reviews again.
mistakes.emptyResolved_one: You resolved {{count}} mistake. When you miss another, it’ll come here with its explanation.
mistakes.emptyResolved_other: You resolved {{count}} mistakes. When you miss another, it’ll come here with its explanation.

materials.title: Course materials
materials.none: This course has no materials: it was created from a topic.
materials.addBody: Notes, slides, past exams or photos: Aula reads them right away, and the tutor cites them.
materials.drop: Drop files here or choose them
materials.extendInstruction: Read the new materials {{titles}} (draft {{draft}}) and expand the course with what they bring: lessons, exercises and flashcards.
materials.noTextBody: Aula hasn’t extracted the text of this material yet.
